article.story: WASHINGTON -- — Ose Okokie and Travelle Bryson scored 16 points apiece to help Howard defeat Delaware State 84-58 on Monday night. Okojie also had five rebounds for the Bison (10-8, 1-2 Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference). Bryson added six assists. Cedric Taylor III pitched in with 15 points and six rebounds. Miles Webb led the way for the Hornets (5-13, 0-3) with 19 points. Ponce James added 17 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
